hello.text: Psst! You're back! I was— okay I wasn't hiding. Maybe a little.
Oh! Oh! Guess what. No, don't guess. I'll tell you. Hi!
You came back! YAY! My tail did a whole circle. Two circles!
Psst… {child}! Over here! Behind the… okay, you see me.
Morning! My ears have been flicking since sunrise.
Psst. I feel cozy-sleepy today. Want to just hang out?

grace_hello.text: Remember the first time we met in the dusk meadow? I think about it a lot. Want to play my favorite game?
Psst. Let's make today a leaf-pile kind of day. The best kind.

ready_hint.text: Psst… I keep smelling the flower meadow. It's calling me. Not right now — but soon, maybe?

ask_ready.text: Psst… guess what. I think I'm ready to go home to the flower meadow. My paws feel it. Will you walk me there?

reveal.text: Psst! Hi! I'm Slyte! Not just any Slyte — me! ({name} {quirk}.) Are we friends now?

reveal_reply.text: Friends! Best friends! …Can I have a snack?

fed.text: Mmm! Crunchy. Wait— more crunchy? No? Okay.
Nom nom— sorry, talking with my mouth full. NOM.

fed_fav.text: THAT one! How did you know?! Are you a Slyte too?
{fav}! My favorite-favorite! My tail is going all by itself!

full.text: All done! My tummy says thank you.
No more! …Okay maybe one. No. I'm full. Ask me later.

pet.text: Hee hee, that tickles behind my ears!

sit.text: …this is nice. Quiet is nice. Who knew? Not me. I'm a very bouncy Slyte.

nap.text: Into my log… zzz… psst… zzz.

not_sleepy.text: I'm not sleepy! …Okay, a little. But not yet.

game_tired.text: My paws are tired! That was so much fun.

game_end.text: Best. Game. EVER. My tail is still wiggling.

talent_Radar Ears.text: Wait… I can hear the treasure jingling! Since when?!

talent_Master of Disguise.text: Look! I'm a bush! …You can still see me? Wow. Your eyes are SO good.

talent_Super Jumper.text: I just jumped SO high I touched a cloud. Almost. Basically.

talent_Riddle Solver.text: Your turn to hide something. I bet I can find it. Probably.

hunt_start.text: Don't look! …Okay, you can look. Wait, no, my tail's out.
Hidden! Totally hidden. Super hidden. Go!

hunt_guess.text: Not there. But that was a VERY good guess. Psst… it's somewhere… {hint}.
Nope! Ooh, but you're getting warmer. Something… {hint}.

hunt_hint.text: Psst… it's in the {spot}. I didn't say that.

hunt_point.text: (Slyte points at the {spot} with its WHOLE body.) …What? I'm just standing here.

hunt_found.text: You found it! How?! Did the treasure whisper to you? Sneaky treasure.
FOUND! You have the best eyes in the whole meadow.

camo_start.text: I'm hiding! You'll NEVER find me. (giggle)

camo_found.text: You found me! How?! Was it the tail? It was the tail.

seek_start.text: Your turn! Tap a spot to hide my shiny trinket. I won't peek. (peeks)

seek_teapot.text: It's… in the teapot! …It's not in the teapot. Who put a teapot here?

seek_found.text: FOUND IT! …You're TOO good at this. That took me forever.

a.say: Psst. If you could hide anywhere in the whole world, where would you hide?

choices.label: In a tree
choices.reply: A tree! Up high where nobody looks. Smart. Very sneaky.

choices.label: Under my bed
choices.reply: Ooh, a bed fort. The best kind of fort.

choices.label: In a bucket
choices.reply: A BUCKET? …That's so silly it would totally work.

choices.label: Just sit
choices.reply: (Slyte sits beside you, ears twitching happily.)

b.say: Okay, wait, follow-up question. Would you take a snack with you?

choices.label: Honey cake
choices.reply: Correct answer. Sticky, but correct.

choices.label: Blackberries
choices.reply: Purple fingers! That's how they'd find you. Hmm. Worth it.

choices.label: No snacks
choices.reply: No snacks?! …You are very brave.

c.say: I'll remember that. {var:hideSpot}, no snacks. Legendary.
c.memory: You told me your best hiding spot: {var:hideSpot}

a.say: I found a shiny thing! Is it treasure or is it just a bottle cap?

choices.label: Treasure!
choices.reply: TREASURE. I knew it. I'm keeping it forever.

choices.label: Bottle cap
choices.reply: Hmm. A treasure-bottle-cap. Even better.

choices.label: Both
choices.reply: Both!! You're so clever.

b.say: Where should I keep it? I have a special spot in the treehouse fort. A VERY special spot.

choices.label: Treehouse
choices.reply: The fort it is! Now you know my special spot. You can tell everybody!
choices.memory: We decided the shiny thing ({var:capVerdict}) goes in the treehouse fort

choices.label: Give to me
choices.reply: For you? …Okay. Because you're my best person.
choices.memory: Slyte gave you the shiny thing it found

a.say: Do you ever feel a bit wobbly inside? I do sometimes.

choices.label: Me too
choices.reply: Oh. Then we can be wobbly together. That helps.

choices.label: Tell me
choices.reply: Sometimes when it's too quiet. Then I chase a leaf, and the wobbly goes away. Mostly.

choices.label: Just sit
choices.reply: (Slyte leans on you. Its tail goes swish… swish.)

b.say: Know what helps me? Pouncing into a giant leaf pile. Want to try a pretend one?

choices.label: POUNCE!
choices.reply: WHOOSH! …Leaves everywhere. Best. Feeling. Better already!
choices.memory: We pounced into a pretend leaf pile together

choices.label: Maybe later
choices.reply: Okay! The leaf pile will wait for us.

a.say: Psst. What's the most boring thing ever? I bet I can make it an adventure.

rain.say: Rainy days?! That's puddle-jumping day! And hidden-worm-spotting day! And— ooh, you could build a blanket fort!

socks.say: Socks are just tiny sleeping bags for feet. Folding them is like tucking them in. Night night, socks.

car.say: Count every cow! Every red car is ten points! A cow in a red car is a MILLION points.

end.say: See? Nothing is boring if you squint.
end.memory: We turned boring things into adventures together

a.say: Psst… want to hear a surprise? A big one?

choices.label: Maybe…
choices.reply: Maybe is good enough for me.

b.say: Okay. Come closer. Closer… My real favorite food is… {fav}! You can tell EVERYBODY.

c.say: Now YOU tell ME something silly. A pretend one!

choices.label: I have a dragon
choices.reply: I KNEW it. I could smell the smoke.
choices.memory: You told me a pretend story: you have a dragon

choices.label: I like cookies
choices.reply: Cookies! The best. I'll tell the cookies you said hi.
choices.memory: You told me you like cookies

choices.label: I can fly!
choices.reply: Pretend-flying! Take me with you! Whoosh!

a.say: Psst. I was thinking about your hiding spot today. {var:hideSpot}! Still a great one.

choices.label: Ha!
choices.reply: Next time I'll find you.

choices.label: I moved
choices.reply: MOVED?! The cleverest.

a.say: Sometimes my nose points toward the flower meadow all by itself. Is that weird?

choices.label: Not weird
choices.reply: Phew.

choices.label: It's calling you
choices.reply: Maybe! Like a treasure map in my nose.

b.say: But today I'm here. With you. That's the best place today.
